partnership_announcements.description: VOID Technologies and Thanh Phu Packaging announced a strategic partnership to develop and launch high-performance, sustainable voided MDO PE films and packaging for global food and hygiene markets.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: VOID Technologies is engaged in developing polymeric compositions for manufacturing articles with internal cavities, as described in 'Polyolefin composition with ionomeric cavitation agent' and 'Olefin-Based Polymer Composition with Voiding Agent and Article.' These innovations involve a continuous polymeric phase, such as polyolefin, combined with dispersed cavitation or voiding agents, including ionomeric and functionalized styrene polymers. Their research focuses on advanced materials with engineered internal structures.

overview_description.description: VOID Technologies is a groundbreaking materials science company spun out of Kimberly-Clark to commercialise the VO+ technology. Our business model is based on supplying VO+ additive masterbatches to film manufacturers.
